newsitem.title: USA: Baking stocks seen improving investment menu - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Baking stocks seen improving investment menu - NYT.

text.p: Baking company stocks are an attractive investment, despite historical obstacles such as raw material costs and low margins, Morgan Keegan & Co stockbroker James Holmes said in an interview in the New York Times on Sunday.
The baking industry used to be contained mostly within larger food companies, but recent ownership changes and spinoffs have offered a few good investments, Holmes said.
Some tasty baking stocks include Interstate Bakeries Corp, Flowers Industries Inc and Earthgrains Co, according to Holmes.
